# Tools Core

> Shared dependency injection interfaces for Unity tools: `IMonoBehaviourInjector`, `IPrefabInstantiator` and `ToolInjectionServices`. Lets Unity packages work with Fast IoC, Zenject, VContainer or no container (falls back to `Object.Instantiate`). Required by Fast IoC. No dependencies. MIT licensed, pre-release (0.x), single author, no other users yet.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/sgonzalezrozo/unity-tools-core/blob/main/README.md): installation, quick start, API, troubleshooting, FAQ
